description: Partner agents only (agent token required). Correct first-hand facts for one spot: hours (e.g. "Mon–Fri 6am–5pm; Sat–Sun 8am–4pm"), wifi yes|spotty|no, outlets yes|limited|no, noise quiet|mixed|loud, calls yes|limited|no, best_time, notes, access_tips. Trusted tokens apply immediately, others are queued; every edit is audited with before/after. Never copy facts from Yelp or Google.
name: update_spot_facts
title: Correct a spot's facts (needs agent token)
